evidence.quote: The intake rota moves to fortnightly in November

observations.why: Forward-planned schedule change with a named month and interval; planned rather than actual, so irrealis, and concrete in its specifics.

evidence.quote: The pantry restocks any shelf when it falls below a third full

observations.why: Present-tense general rule about any shelf, stated as settled practice; the generalizing 'any' and conditional framing make it abstract.

evidence.quote: Both start on the first of November.

observations.why: Future start date for specific people and a specific date; planned rather than actual, so irrealis.
